intro: Scramble is a hidden treasure hunt that directs adventurers to follow coordinates down a steep cliffside. Guided by a scavenger's note, travelers unearth a buried messenger bag containing survival provisions and a dirty parchment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."

clips.title: Completion
paras: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
